t: Funds are hereby authorized to be appropriated for the Department of Defense for fiscal year 2017 for expenses, not otherwise provided for, for Drug Interdiction and Counter-Drug Activities, Defense-wide, as specified in the funding table in section 4501.

fable.w: This section only authorizes appropriations to the Department of Defense for drug interdiction and counter-drug activities for fiscal year 2017. The only tempting reading is that "activities" might imply some coordination, but the text names no outside party, consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue. It is a funding authorization that stays entirely inside the federal government.
